strix_findings.title: SQL Injection in /user endpoint id parameter
strix_findings.description: The `/user` endpoint directly interpolates user input from the `id` parameter into a SQLite query string, leading to SQL Injection.
strix_findings.poc:
1. Send a GET request to `/user?id=1 OR 1=1`.
2. Observe that all database records are returned.

strix_findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in /hello endpoint name parameter
strix_findings.description: The `/hello` endpoint uses f-string interpolation to include user-supplied input in a template rendered by `render_template_string`, leading to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI).
strix_findings.poc:
1. Send a GET request to `/hello?name={{7*7}}`.
2. Observe the response `Hello 49`.
3. Use advanced Jinja2 payloads to achieve remote code execution.
